content.text:
The visible suite now passes (3 tests). I changed two files.

- **`solution/util.py`:** `_parse_field` always returned `restricted=False` for any field other than a bare `*`. As a result, `core.py` treated every day-of-month and day-of-week field as a wildcard. I changed it to return `True` unless the field starts with `*`. That follows Vixie cron, where `*/n` still counts as a wildcard for day matching.
- **`solution/core.py`:** When both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted, `day_ok` required both to match. Standard cron matches if either one does, so I changed that `and` to `or`. The visible tests don't exercise this case, so it is untested here.
